headline: Issue #47 landed — fleet-dispatch safety layer, the build-first gate the mayor issue itself named before scheduling. scripts/fleet-dispatch.mjs gained applySafetyGates (lease -> overlap -> budget, in that order) between tier-routing and dispatch: B.2 claim/lease (lib/tasks/lease.mjs, migration 0009_task_lease_touches.sql not yet applied) atomically claims a short-TTL lease immediately pre-dispatch, closing the double-dispatch race two concurrent runs could hit; B.3 file-overlap (lib/tasks/overlap.mjs + revived scripts/check-unit-overlap.mjs CLI, registered in docs/guardrails/registry.json manual channel) refuses to fire a task whose declared `touches` overlap an in-flight task's; B.1 spend ceiling (lib/tasks/budget.mjs pure projection mined from auto-assigner.mjs's PRICE_PER_M_TOKENS + lib/ops/spend-log.mjs committed ledger) caps per-run + daily PROJECTED USD spend (not metered actual). touches isn't populated anywhere yet (no UI, no inference) so the overlap gate is an honor-system placeholder pending a follow-up. Scoped down from the issue's much larger consolidated spec to just the DoD's blocking gates; B.4 (wall-clock/pod caps), B.5 (Discord read), and wiring the actual scheduled Routine are explicit follow-ups. Migration 0009 not yet applied; new unit tests UNVERIFIED by a real run (sandbox Bash approval unavailable for node/pnpm/vitest) -- see HANDOFF Next queue item 7 before trusting this live. PREVIOUS: Issue #44 landed — auto-record preview_url on leads (scripts/sync-preview-urls.mjs). Pure matchPreviewUpdates(projects, leads) pairs each Vercel project with a READY preview deployment (read via lib/projects listProjects) to a lead by config.slug (hirobius- prefix stripped), then --apply stamps preview_url + status='rendered' via updateLead — the same write the manual 'render' action makes, so a deployed site self-registers as the clickable link in /ops Leads with zero manual paste. Dry-run default, fill-only/idempotent (skips leads that already have a URL), preview-only (production/live_url deliberately out of scope), fail-soft without VERCEL_TOKEN, notify+run-log per record. 13 new unit tests; typecheck/typecheck:api/lint 0-0/vitest 438-438 all green; api/*.ts stays 11/12. Intended to run in the mayor Routine alongside fleet-dispatch.mjs (not yet wired to a live schedule). Closes the manual-paste nav gap from the first-lead→preview session. PREVIOUS: Fleet auto-dispatch epic #41 Slice 5 — stale-dispatch watchdog (scripts/fleet-watchdog.mjs), findStale re-dispatch/flag, dry-run default. Slices 1-4 (board fields+tier routing, headless dispatcher, approvals inbox, observability) landed prior. Production LIVE.
